application_review: The actual finite image normed model is linearly identified with the original graded coefficient algebra. The existing array exponential chart has a proved literal integer evaluation formula in those coefficients.

Integer input translation is conjugate, via the original exponential chart, to its actual finite-dimensional linear coefficient substitution. This proves infinite smoothness of the original translation and its opposite-shift inverse; a diffeomorphism with exactly the existing pointwise translation is constructed.

Every integer-valued real coefficient polynomial of degree at most one exponentiates against the original logarithm to the exact power array. Consequently constant arrays and the original affine model arrays g^(k+sum z_j Delta_j)*x belong to the actual native array group, without using an assumed identification with the older generated group or an unproved BCH expansion.

The actual affine model arrays have exact original evaluations, arbitrary input-shift and unit-coordinate-shift formulas. Constant arrays are fixed by shifts. The time-parameterized original model is proved to be the linear orbit of the constant array g^t in that same group.

The original affine model orbit descends to the exact all-integer lattice coset space. Literal quotient evaluations, the true left group action linear-orbit formula and input-translation compatibility are proved for arbitrary original subgroup Gamma, without normality. Finite products and downstream quantitative Alignment estimates remain separate obligations.

Reviewed original-chart conjugacy: the finite image model is only linearly re-expressed, and the existing original exponential homeomorphism is retained. The diffeomorphism applies exactly the previous native array translation.

Reviewed model-array membership: affine real polynomials have total degree at most one, so the retained degree-minus-one condition allows the original logarithm coefficient. Original exponential integer-scaling and subgroup multiplication give the precise model formula, including negative integers.

Reviewed orbit handedness and nonnormal quotient: the orbit is left multiplication by a power of the constant array, not a quotient-group product. The coset action is the actual group action on left cosets.
No smooth quotient atlas or smooth quotient evaluation is asserted. Finite-product joint models and quantitative Alignment work remain explicit.

All new named declarations are strictly elaborated and their transitive axiom dependencies checked. Prior proof sources and axiom sets remain unchanged; no independent replay or complete StrongConjecture proof is claimed.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. All-integer multiplication compatibility, the exact full exponential array subgroup, its group isomorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism with the finite image, contractibility, simply connectedness, and discreteness of its pointwise Gamma-valued subgroup for discrete Gamma are now proved. Cocompactness of the exact all-integer pointwise lattice is now proved by actual lattice monomial spanning, rational-log intersection, positive-root character descent and continuous quotient transfer. The actual integrated subalgebra and full native array group now have constructed smooth manifold and Lie group structures on their inherited topologies, and all literal integer evaluations are smooth. The actual array group and exact lattice instantiate the existing NativeNilmanifoldData interface at the same original nilpotency step, with constructed compatible quotient metric. Integer input translations now preserve the actual graded coefficient Lie algebra, the full native exponential array group and its exact all-integer lattice; actual group and coset homeomorphisms and continuous coset evaluation with exact translation compatibility are proved. Array input translations are now proved smooth with smooth inverses in the existing original exponential charts. Original affine power-times-basepoint model arrays are proved to belong to the actual native array group; their exact evaluations, input translations and linear time orbit are proved both in the group and in its exact lattice coset space. Smooth quotient charts and quotient evaluation maps, finite-product joint-state assembly and downstream model-orbit integration remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the finite-product native polynomial-array joint model action and its connection to all prescribed readings, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
